Game Overview

At its heart, Santa StrongLift Christmas is a christmas game about help Santa juggle a barbell laden with holiday gifts in this festive gravity-defying challenge. Master your strategic moves and quick reflexes to keep him balanced. With each wobbly lift, conquer trickier levels and embrace the merriment of a yuletide workout packed with laughter and cheer.
